Antibiotic.name: Antibiotico
Antibiotic.description: Se un bersaglio ha iniziato il processo di guarigione naturale iniettandole l'Antibiotico, li farà guarire altri 2 Punti Ferita al giorno per una settimana. Questo effetto non si accumula.

Black Lace.name: Black Lace
Black Lace.description:
Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user rolls 2d6 Humanity Loss which is returned if they pass the Secondary Effect save
  • The user ignores Seriously Wounded wound states for the duration


Secondary Effect (DV17)

When the dose wears off, the user rolls WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 against Secondary DV.

  • On Fail Humanity loss is not returned
  • Unless experiencing the primary effect, REF -2

Blue Glass.name: Blue Glass
Blue Glass.description:
Primary Effect

Dose lasts 4 hours.

  • The GM may occasionally tell the user that they are seeing swirls of colours. When this happens the user loses their action on a single turn

Secondary Effect (DV15)

  • The GM may occasionally tell the user that they are seeing swirls of colours. When this happens the user loses their action on a single turn

Boost.name: Boost
Boost.description:
Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user has INT +2 for the duration

Secondary Effect (DV17)

  • INT -2

Rapidetox.name: Rapidetox
Rapidetox.description: Iniettando un paziente con Rapidetox eliminerà tutti gli effetti di qualsiasi droga, veleni o intossicanti attualmente in corso.

Smash.name: Smash
Smash.description:
Primary Effect

Dose lasts 4 hours.

  • The user feels happy and satisfied
  • +2 to Dance / Contortionist / Conversation / Human Perception / Persuasion / Acting

Secondary Effect (DV15)

  • -2 to Dance / Contortionist / Conversation / Human Perception / Persuasion / Acting
  • GM will tell your when you crave more Smash. Roleplay accordingly.

Speedheal.name: Speedheal
Speedheal.description: Un paziente che non sia Morente recupera subito un numero di Punti Ferita pari alla somma di FIS+VOL. Si può ricevere una sola dose al giorno.

Stim.name: Stim
Stim.description: Per un’ora, il paziente ignora le penalità dello Soglia Ferito Gravemente. Si può riceve una sola dose al giorno.

Surge.name: Surge
Surge.description: Il paziente può agire senza penalità per la mancanza di sonno per un giorno. Si può riceverne una sola dose a settimana.

Synthcoke.name: Synthcoke
Synthcoke.description:
Primary Effect

Dose lasts 4 hours.

  • +1 REF by 1 point for the duration
  • The user feels paranoid occasionally

Secondary Effect (DV15)

  • -2 REF unless under ther Primary Effect
  • GM will tell you when when you crave mor Synthcoke. Roleplay Acordingly
